# DSA-110 reference code

The baseline uses RFI detector code from the DSA-110 real-time pipeline.
The copied source files are unmodified, at revision
`c953f98780494379ef6ec6de5e3e29034c9a8d57`.
The course interface is in `src/cs163_rfi/flagging.py`.

The upstream GPL-3.0 license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
